h1: Custom Quinn Pennants for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Quinn pennants in bulk for branding. Perfect for events, schools & teams. Get a quote at PerfectImprints.com.
introHtml: Quinn pennants offer a classic felt construction that holds up to repeated use at pep rallies, trade shows, and retail displays. The dense material accepts screen printing and heat transfer decoration cleanly, so your logo or mascot stays sharp. Bulk buyers choose Quinn when they need a traditional pennant shape with consistent color saturation across hundreds of units. These felt pennants are a reliable option for schools, sports teams, and promotional events that call for a vintage feel.
heroAltText: Custom Quinn pennants in felt with screen-printed logo, ideal for school spirit and promotional events
